messages:
mara (AE): AcmeGov wants a Gov-hosted POC. Requirements: SDK streaming, function/tool calls, strict structured JSON output. Customer insists on customer KMS/HSM and no third-party egress. Can SEs triage?

devon (SE): I can take this. Quick clarifying Q: Hosted Gov support for customer KMS? Currently Hosted supports Redwood-managed keys only; Private/VPC supports customer KMS/HSM.

mara (AE): They prefer Hosted to avoid infra ops, but security demands customer-managed keys and no external telemetry. Also they route traffic through a corporate proxy and want websocket support.

devon (SE): Blockers noted:
- KMS/HSM: Hosted != customer HSM. Private/VPC = OK for customer KMS/HSM.
- Websockets via corporate proxy: if WS is blocked we can do SSE or chunked HTTP; need proxy handshake details (allowed headers, timeouts).

ops-bot: ACTION: feature-flag "gov-hosted" not enabled for this org; file infra enable ticket if Hosted required.

sanjay (Solutions): POC workaround: emulate streaming with SSE. Minimal curl demo:

curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://api.redwood-gov.example/v1/streams?model=rw-gov-1"

This emits fragments like:
data: {"type":"delta","role":"assistant","delta":{"content":"partial token..."}}

devon (SE): Example SSE fragments demonstrating a streaming function call then final structured result:
data: {"type":"function_call","name":"lookup_account","arguments":{"acct_id":"123"}}
...
data: {"type":"function_result","name":"lookup_account","result":{"status":"ok","balance":4523.10}}

jordan (AcmeGov): Can the SDK send an authenticated webhook into our VPC? We cannot accept callbacks from arbitrary IPs without egress audit.

devon (SE): Recommended pattern: Private deployment or a short-lived in-VPC connector that relays signed events. Flow: Redwood -> signed request -> connector IP allowlist -> local app. Sample header: X-Redwood-Signature: sha256=HEX

legal: Security asks: provide SOC2 Type II (redacted) and a KMS architecture diagram showing where keys live, what Redwood services see plaintext, and what logs are emitted. SEs, please produce the doc.

devon (SE): I'll draft the KMS diagram and a short note: hosted-gov = Redwood-managed keys, no customer HSM; private/vpc = customer KMS/HSM supported and telemetry can be constrained. Also will add a tiny sample repo with SSE + function-call SDK snippets.

mara (AE): Pricing question from buyer: 3-month POC, ~200k tokens/day, ~100 concurrent streaming sessions. Any ballpark for quoting?

devon (SE): Ballpark: reserved throughput + burst = ~$6k-12k/mo depending on model. Sales should include buffer for connector engineering/time and Private fallback costs.

mara (AE): Next steps: devon to produce PoC repo/snippets + KMS diagram; legal to start sec questionnaire draft; I'll prepare POC quote including reserved option and Private fallback. Sync tomorrow 11:00 PT. :thumbsup:

jordan (AcmeGov): Thanks — can you share the SSE + function-call snippet by EOD?
